name: product-description-writer
description: Drafts a description, bullet points and SEO title and meta description for every new product, ready for you to review before anything is saved.

howItWorks.label: Does
howItWorks.text: Writes a description, bullet points and SEO meta from the product's own details

howItWorks.label: Asks you
howItWorks.text: To approve the copy before it is saved to the product

data.description: The long description shown on the product page
Fields that describe the product: material, dimensions, colour, care, attributes, variants
The product's category or collection, for context
The page title used by search engines
The meta description used by search engines

parameters.label: Language
parameters.description: The language to write the copy in

parameters.label: Description length
parameters.description: short is about 50 words, medium about 120, long about 250

parameters.label: Number of bullet points
parameters.description: How many key-feature bullets to write (0 to skip bullets)

parameters.label: Rewrite existing copy
parameters.description: When off, fields that already have text are left alone
